documents.title: POL-U2100.02 Ensuring Academic Honesty
documents.quality_note: Official policy; unauthorized use of computer-generated text (generative AI) and AI-produced plagiarism are named as violations.

documents.title: FAQs: Generative AI in Teaching, Learning, & Technology Guidelines
documents.quality_note: FAQ with university guidance for instructors and students on permitted use, syllabus statements and data.

notes: WWU has no single university AI policy; it leaves decisions to instructors. The AI Hub guidance page is an index of links (not collected). The Academic Honesty syllabus-sample-language URL returned a 404. The History Department AI policy exists (not computing, so not collected). No CS department or CSE/College of Science & Engineering policy found; the three known WWU URLs are CSCI course pages (deferred).
